purpose: Vehicle-scoped signal catalog, manually submitted history, live chart/tail and two-snapshot comparison workspace.
primaryGoal: Inspect selected signals over time or between snapshots while retaining source identity, raw values, explanations, pinning and export actions.

dataSources.behavior: Context signal-diff:vehicle:{vehicleId}; item signal:{name}; sequential bulk pin/unpin skips already-correct states. No mutation executed.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Derive names from the existing typed catalog owner; preserve metadata, order, enablement, cancellation and intentional cache compatibility.

issues.detail: Promise.all rejects the aggregate on one signal request failure; successful neighbors and individual pending/failed identities are not exposed by this query.
issues.fix: Integrate per-signal evidence with retained payloads and independent retry; preserve Run boundary, six-request cap and selected missing-sample placeholders. Existing useSignalHistoryBatch also uses Promise.all and is not by itself a partial-failure fix.

issues.detail: Pin query loading/error is discarded in favor of data default []; pinnedSignals.size is sent as zero to both summaries before a successful pin response.
issues.fix: Keep the query state and represent unknown/loading/failure separately from a measured zero; retain pin identities/actions and context.

visualIssues.detail: Saturated bg-red-500 animate-pulse adds ambient visual noise; SignalChartPanel.tsx:175,182 repeats red pulses. LiveSignalTail.tsx:146 has a motion-reduce override but still pulses by default.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing subdued semantic live cues and static status; keep labels/connection meaning and saved chart preferences. Verify global reduced-motion behavior separately.

visualIssues.detail: Default preview accent is hardcoded cyan #22d3ee, independent of the shared palette/theme. Actual composed contrast not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Resolve default through existing chart palette owner while preserving color override and samples; do not introduce another palette or reset saved preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Signal-name body text inherits full CHART_COLORS; SignalHistoryTable.tsx:151 does likewise. Saturation/contrast depends on resolved palette.
visualIssues.fix: Keep series swatches/identity but use canonical primary/secondary body text; preserve data and saved chart colors.

visualIssues.detail: Glossary p/span uses ad-hoc text-xs rather than role typography. Its muted color already uses a theme variable.
visualIssues.fix: Compose Text/Caption with semantic as overrides; retain translated lead, glossary terms, wrapping and test ID.

architectureIssues.detail: Page rebuilds browser-local calendar midnight/inclusive end instead of using startInstant/endInstantExclusive. useRangeState.ts:656-673 explicitly supports rolling live/24h and selected timezone calendar boundaries.
architectureIssues.fix: Use canonical instants in a committed typed Run request; verify handler bound semantics before changing inclusivity. Keep shared header owner and independent A/B business windows.

architectureIssues.detail: Key omits selected signals, bounds and fetch limit; queryFn reads changing values and does not accept/forward signal. Refetch can reuse one key with changed scope.
architectureIssues.fix: Integrate existing typed history/batch owner with immutable submitted parameters, keyed scope and AbortSignal; retain manual Run, cache/retry policy and bounded concurrency.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045 loaded scope is not full-range proof
architectureIssues.detail: Per-signal row cap drives aggregates and totalTableRows at 295. Adaptation drops returned range/count metadata; loaded total is not proven full server total.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep returned bounds/limits/source evidence and explain loaded scope; preserve currently loaded rows, sorting and pagination. Do not fabricate completeness or change calculations silently.

architectureIssues.detail: Live/Compare are local state while permalink and saved views serialize currentQuery at 363-367,402-404. Mode itself cannot be restored from those query parameters.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing URL-state mechanism for validated mutually exclusive mode, retaining historical fallback and every existing URL key.

architectureIssues.detail: Before/after last charge computes now minus four hours; last drive computes now minus 90/5 minutes. These are not source-backed event boundaries.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve preset actions and accurately localize their relative-window meaning unless an existing verified event source is integrated; do not invent capabilities.

architectureIssues.detail: Footer says catalog refreshes every 5s; inspected available hooks show staleTime but no refetchInterval. Inherited policy has not been inspected, so a definite polling mismatch is not established.
architectureIssues.fix: Verify effective canonical query policy then align localized explanation; do not add polling simply to justify the text.

architectureIssues.detail: Page imports data adaptation/type directly from root components/SignalQueryControls and owns request/aggregation logic. The adapter creates timestamp/name/typed scalar rows but drops envelope metadata.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse typed signal query/adapter ownership outside UI modules; retain numeric/string/boolean/null semantics and provide truthful metadata detail without silently deleting current adapted JSON.

dataBehavior: Preserve raw wire/cache SI and source identity; display formatting/localization remains in existing owners. Do not guess signal units or introduce legacy conversion helpers.
Adapter preserves timestamp/name and finite numeric/boolean/string/null values; expanded JSON currently represents adapted rows, not the complete original envelope.
History row order descending; chart timestamp grouping/ascending order and boolean 1/0 versus null; history stats numeric-only.
Six-request limit, per-signal cap 1000, loaded-row pagination and all loaded values must survive; expose limits truthfully rather than asserting full-range totals.

Live chart five-minute window/500ms flush; aggregates are cumulative until reset, not necessarily window-only; tail rate one-second, buffer 500, pause tail only, separate full event tail and selected chart.
Keep table IDs telemetry:signal-stats, telemetry:signal-history, telemetry:live-signal-tail and signal-diff-table.
Diff retains A/B values, source/age, numeric delta/percentage and pinned-first alphabetical ordering.
Export columns signal/window_a/window_b/source_a/source_b and filename signal-diff-vehicle-{vehicleId}.csv; current Copy CSV label triggers download.
Pin type widget, signal:{name}, signal-diff:vehicle:{vehicleId}; preserve saved-view identity and URL keys signals,catq,cats,catopen,chart,page,size,a,b,q,cat plus existing range state.
Retain every translated label/explanation and setting. Unknown/failure/pending is not measured zero; mode visibility is not permission to remove capabilities.
